attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 thakre-shelter dhunche-market
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 dhunche-market thakre-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car2 thakre-shelter myagang-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 myagang-care-home dhunche-market
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 dhunche-market thakre-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 adult 1
defer dhunche-market adult 1
defer tadi-market adult 7
defer shivapuri-village child 1
</plan>
COST: 330

Driving: car1 takes 46 minutes (round trip to Dhunche market) and car2 takes 64 minutes (Thakre to Myagang, Myagang to Dhunche, Dhunche back to Thakre). Deferred penalties: 20 (one adult at Dhunche), 140 (seven adults at Tadi), and 60 (one child at Shivapuri), for a total of 220.

All four injured are rescued, along with the three elderly and one adult. Each remaining adult costs 20 to defer, but any trip to Tadi market costs at least 98 minutes round trip for at most four people, so deferring those adults is cheaper. Reaching the child at Shivapuri village costs at least 88 minutes round trip, which is more than the 60 penalty.
